caption: The drawing depicts two identical metal cowbells positioned side by side on a plain beige background. Each cowbell is shown from a different angle: the left cowbell is positioned upright with its bottom flat on the surface, showing the side and top, while the right cowbell is displayed lying on its side, exposing the open bottom and the clapper inside. Both cowbells are brownish-gold with areas of greenish patina, suggesting aged metal. Each bell features a raised star-like pattern on one side and a small circular rivet near the bottom. The handles are looped metal, dark in color, attached to the top. The right cowbell clearly shows the internal clapper suspended from a rod, which appears cylindrical and matches the outer color. The artist’s signature, “Elmer Weise,” is written below the cowbells on the left side in small black and yellow script. The background is uniformly plain without any additional objects or elements.
title: Cow Bell, #1
